locations_note: TODO owner: Instagram location ids for Malappuram places (keyword -> id, Malayalam and English keywords, e.g. "manjeri": "<id>", "മഞ്ചേരി": "<id>"); "default" = the Malappuram district id. Empty = no location tag.

reel_voice_alt.note: owner rule: Google Charon reads EVERY reel, ONLY inside Google's free allowance (1 million characters a month); the code stops at 700,000 (safety margin: some usage records can be lost when posting jobs save at the same time), then Midhun (edge-tts) until the 1st; Midhun also whenever Google fails. Never paid. Needs secret GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY

prime_time.note: owner 4 Nov: reels go out in the high-view windows (7-9:30, 12:30-14:30, 18:30-22 IST), at least gap_minutes apart, no daily maximum (owner 12 Nov: daily_max 0 = no limit; was 6), never in quiet_hours. Urgent news posts outside the windows (but not in quiet hours); a reel that waited max_wait_hours posts at the next non-quiet moment; nothing is dropped

reel_punch_note: every reel opens with a spoken punch line (yellow number + headline) while the big headline is on screen

reach.note: each switch can be turned off here without code changes
reach.place_tags_note: Malayalam stem -> hashtag. Stems stop before a final chillu (ർ ൽ ൾ) because it changes with suffixes; longer names first (the first match wins).

selection.note: owner 11 Nov (goal: new followers): news few people watch is not written - ceremonies, inaugurations, meetings, awards, tributes, party politics, court hearings, protests, proposals, tips/recipes, editorials (research_free/collect.py low_interest). Power cuts, health alerts, holidays, road/water closures, jobs, accidents and crime are always written. Useful news and local pride go first in the queue. false = off
